Medical Colleges Increase MBBS Seats; Other Education News Emerges

The National Medical Commission (NMC) has approved increases in MBBS seats at several government medical colleges across India, including in Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Srinagar. Separately, news outlets reported on recruitment for the bullet train project, a data breach involving CUET candidates, AI training for students, and admissions to undergraduate programs at Delhi University and IITs.
